combined_red_failures_are: Two token-budget assertions plus lease auto-reconnect and lease detached-response subtests; identity counterparts were already repaired before this combined run.

findings.surface: BlobLease renewal and release token exchange
findings.failure: Token request timeout was 5 seconds when conservative lease lifetime was only 1.5 or 1 second.
findings.fix: The token exchange budget is capped by the minimum request deadline and previous lease expiry.
findings.qualification: The pre-fix implementation rejected lease writes after observing expiry; the defect was excess blocking beyond the ownership deadline, not an observed Graph write.

findings.failure: KeyboardInterrupt during the result wait bypassed stop(); a delayed connect could resume and begin the credential request after caller cancellation.
findings.red_evidence: Independently reproduced by transport review agent before identity owner fix; owner native cancellation RED/GREEN artifacts. Already fixed before combined independent RED run.
findings.fix: Cancellation cleanup now covers BaseException around worker start/result wait; delayed connect checks cancellation before dispatch.

findings.failure: Timeout closed the connected socket after the cancellation check but before request send. stdlib auto_open reconnected and sent after the caller returned.
findings.red_evidence: review-independent-red.txt for lease; independent pre-fix reproduction and identity owner RED/GREEN for identity.
findings.fix: Automatic reconnect is disabled immediately after the explicit connection; a closed socket cannot trigger fresh dispatch.

findings.surface: Identity and lease detached HTTP response cleanup
findings.failure: Connection: close detached conn.sock while HTTPResponse retained the socket. A slow body kept the worker and one of four slots alive after the caller deadline.
findings.red_evidence: review-independent-red.txt for lease; independent pre-fix reproduction and identity owner RED/GREEN for identity.
findings.fix: The native transports retain the connected socket separately for cancellation shutdown and close the response in the worker finally path.
findings.fixture: Real stdlib HTTPConnection/getresponse with a local socketpair; no remote networking or Azure calls.

boundaries: Unknown acquire, renew and release responses never recover local authority or trigger automatic retry.
An expired local owner does not release a new modeled remote owner.
One role admits one acquisition attempt under four concurrent callers.
Identical secret bytes in a different credential handle do not satisfy identity binding.
Storage tokens remain opaque and use the fixed tenant route, backend client and storage scope.
Wrong-origin configuration is rejected before service IO.
A Blob lease is not Graph fencing or operation approval.
remaining_limits: No live Azure lease, RBAC, tenant, TLS endpoint, Graph or Intune calls were made.
Default optional expected_etag means ownership only; state revision pinning needs an explicit fresh condition and separate re-observation.
An OS resolver can outlive a deadline; worker creation remains capped at four and cancellation prevents subsequent credential dispatch.
The local socketpair fixture exercises stdlib response ownership and cleanup, not live TLS interoperability.
The protected Python host and credential-holding process remain trusted; malicious mutation of private capability internals is not an isolation boundary.
